title: Silenced touch-caster re-arms melee timer: reset happens before the silence gate
claim: DFU DoTouchSpell resets the melee timer only after its whole condition passes, ending with SetReadySpell (EnemyMotor.cs:621-628), which returns false when silenced (EntityEffectManager.cs:315 SilenceCheck) - a silenced enemy's DoTouchSpell fails without touching MeleeTimer and its ordinary melee fires normally. The port's EnemyCaster.update resets attack.meleeTimer (enemyCasting.js:114) BEFORE returning the touch decision; the silence gate runs later in castEnemySpell (:159) and returns false with the timer already re-armed 1.5-3s. The arm re-fires every time the timer hits 0, usually beating the melee decision (which needs a classic tick plus the DFRandom roll on that exact frame).
consequence: Silence a touch-casting enemy (ghost, Frost Daedra, healer) and in the port it stands in melee range mostly not attacking - its melee timer perpetually re-armed by failed casts - where DFU's silenced caster falls back to normal melee attacks.

title: FACTION_TYPE_INDIVIDUAL is 3 but FactionTypes.Individual is 4 (3 is Subgroup)
claim: staticNpc.js:220 exports FACTION_TYPE_INDIVIDUAL = 3 and staticNpcName:209 tests fd.type === 3. DFU FactionFile.cs:537-538: Subgroup = 3, Individual = 4; StaticNPC.GetDisplayName (:319) tests type == Individual (4). The port's production faction dict agrees with DFU (src/formats/factionFile.js:17 Individual: 4; npcSession.js:62 same), so staticNpcName's check never matches a real Individual and instead matches Subgroup factions. Test pins (staticnpc.test.js:112 uses the constant; audit24_onehome.test.js:196 hardcodes type 3) restate the port, not the C#.
consequence: A named individual (King Gothryd, type 4) clicked in a palace shows a random generated name instead of the faction's fixed name; an NPC whose faction is a Subgroup (type 3, e.g. a knightly order) is named with the faction's own name string.

verify.reason: DFU FactionFile.cs:537-538: Subgroup=3, Individual=4; StaticNPC.cs:319 tests type==(int)Individual(4). Port's staticNpc.js:220 sets FACTION_TYPE_INDIVIDUAL=3, used at :209 - checks Subgroup not Individual. Port's own faction dict and quest code (questMacros.js:321,365; actions.js:2340,2412) correctly use 4 elsewhere, confirming staticNpc.js is the outlier. Both cited test pins mock type:3 as 'individual', restating the bug.

title: collectExteriorNpcs has no production caller: exterior static NPCs never exist
claim: collectExteriorNpcs ports RMBLayout's non-zero-FactionID rule (RMBLayout.cs:366-378, 442-454: SetRMBPeopleData + AddComponent<StaticNPC> + SetupIndividualStaticNPC on every exterior flat with FactionID != 0), but its only importer is test/names.test.js; neither exterior host reads flat factionIDs at all (grep of exterior.js/world.js: zero hits). Known open gap: Port-Ledger.md:338 records it and test/audit18_bible_docs.test.js:334-342 pins the no-caller state (the pin restates the port).
consequence: No exterior static NPC (factioned town flats) is ever an activation/talk/quest target outside; clicking one falls through as scenery, and quests binding individuals at exterior flats cannot land.

verify.reason: collectExteriorNpcs (exteriorNpcs.js:12-14) correctly ports RMBLayout.cs:365-378's non-zero-FactionID rule, but grep of exterior.js/world.js for 'factionID' returns zero hits; only test/names.test.js imports it. test/audit18_bible_docs.test.js:337-338 pins the Port-Ledger.md line documenting this exact known no-caller gap, confirming it, not refuting.

title: Exterior static NPCs are inert - collectExteriorNpcs has no caller
claim: DFU RMBLayout adds a StaticNPC behaviour plus QuestMachine.SetupIndividualStaticNPC to every exterior RMB flat with FactionID != 0 (RMBLayout.cs:370-377 and :446-453), making them clickable talk/quest targets. The port translated the filter (collectExteriorNpcs, exteriorNpcs.js:12-14) but no host calls it: world.js:455-457 and exterior.js:312 add all block flats as plain billboards via addFlat, and the only static-NPC talk paths (worldModes.js:978/1365 talkToStaticNPC) come from collectInteriorPeople.
consequence: NPC flats standing outdoors - courtyard nobles, guards, and individual quest NPCs placed in town exteriors - can never be clicked or talked to, and individual-NPC quest hooks outside never fire.

verify.reason: RMBLayout.cs:366-378/442-454 adds StaticNPC+SetupIndividualStaticNPC when FactionID!=0. collectExteriorNpcs' only caller anywhere is test/names.test.js - zero production callers. world.js:455-456 and exterior.js:312 route all flats through addFlat/flatGroups as plain billboards, no factionID branch. worldModes.js:844-867 explicitly says the click seam is interior-only ('the only host that builds a building interior, so it is the only one with StaticNPCs to click'); openStaticNpc is driven solely by collectInteriorPeople (interiorContext.js:199), never collectExteriorNpcs.
